Theme

Latin word

orbis

orbis, orbis m.

noun, third declension

a round, a cycle; the eyeball, the orb of the eye; a round of turns, a rotation

In this lexicon

  • cycle

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Rep. 1.45; Cic. N.D. 2.52: a planet eundem duodecim signōrum orbem annīs duodecim cōnficit (Lewis & Short)

  • eye

    also used · classical · Verg. A. 12.670: ārdentēs oculōrum orbēs (Lewis & Short); Traupman 58; Traupman 312

  • round

    also used · classical · Liv. 1.17.6: per omnēs in orbem ībat

  • pars orbis terrārum: continent

    classical

  • orbis fīniēns: horizon

    classical

  • orbis volūbilis (lūsōrius): merry-go-round

    modern

  • orbis phōnographicus: record

    modern

  • orbis terrārum, orbis terrārum m.: world

    classical

Examples

  • mīrīque sunt orbēs et quasi circuitūs in rēbus pūblicīs commūtātiōnum et vicissitūdinum

    and there are remarkable cycles and, as it were, rounds of change and alternation in statesCic. Rep. 1.45
